name: Mountain Peacock-Pheasant
rangeDescription: Montane forest of malay peninsula
description: Long-tailed, small-headed, maroon-and-gray pheasant. Male has a longer tail than the female, and his green spots are brighter; they gleam like hewn emeralds when he is displaying.

name: Wrinkled Hornbill
rangeDescription: Malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Brightly-colored medium-large hornbill. Both sexes are black with bare facial skin, blobby throat “pouches”, yellowish tails, and casqued bills.

name: Rufous-collared Robin
rangeDescription: Highlands of s mexico (chiapas) to central honduras
description: Large, bulky thrush of highlands south of Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Found in pine-oak forest, adjacent farmland, and villages.

name: Bearded Guan
rangeDescription: Andes of southern ecuador (but not the east slope) and western andes of northwestern peru
description: Large chickenlike bird with a long tail. Chocolate-brown overall with pinkish-red legs and silvery frosting on head and neck.

name: White-headed Duck
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed mediterranean basin to central asia
description: Remarkable odd-looking diving duck with a long tail, often held cocked. Males have a striking white face and black crown that contrasts with their large blue bill and chestnut body.

name: Usambara Double-collared Sunbird
rangeDescription: Highlands of southeastern kenya (taita hills) and northeastern tanzania
description: A medium-sized sunbird. Males are colorful, green and red, and females drab olive-brownish.

name: Guianan Toucanet
rangeDescription: Far southeastern venezuela to the guianas and northern brazil north of amazon
description: Small toucan of rainforest canopy that is most often seen at fruiting trees at forest edge. Smaller than an aracari and tends not to occur in large groups.

name: Wetar Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (timor and wetar)
description: A fairly large ground-dwelling forest dove. Male is mostly dark with a diagnostic pale head and breast.

name: Black-bellied Seedcracker
rangeDescription: Ivory coast to gabon, northern angola, eastern democratic republic of the congo, tanzania, and northeastern zambia
description: Colorful, chunky waxbill with a massive, conical bill. Both sexes have a red hood and tail, but males have a black base color and more red, and females a brown base color.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Sichuan Tit
rangeDescription: Southwestern china (sichuan to eastern tibet, southeastern qinghai, and northwestern yunnan)
description: Small drab tit with the typical black-head-white-cheek pattern of most tits. Darker-flanked and with a patchier

name: Monteiro's Hornbill
rangeDescription: Arid savanna of southern angola and northern namibia
description: Brown hornbill with a white belly and a yellow-and-orange bill. The white outer tail feathers and wing patches are conspicuous in flight.

name: Red Owl
rangeDescription: Very locally northern and eastern madagascar; most recent records from far north
description: A rare and enigmatic owl that is endemic to Madagascar. Unlikely to be seen unless you are expressly searching for it.

name: Orange-fronted Plushcrown
rangeDescription: Tropical southeastern colombia to northern bolivia and western amazonian brazil
description: Small, yellowish-tan bird. Orange face is unique, but sometimes difficult to see; a more obvious field mark is its bright orange legs.

name: Paria Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern venezuela (anzoátegui, monagas, and sucre)
description: Range-restricted striking sparrow with black head and gray eyebrow. Back and tail olive-yellow, underparts gray; black band across chest.

name: Powerful Owl
rangeDescription: Eastern australia (southeastern queensland to victoria and southeastern south australia)
description: Very large dark brown-and-white owl with underparts heavily marked with dark chevrons and enormous yellow feet. Found around coastal south-eastern Australia.

name: Indian Pond-Heron
rangeDescription: Persian gulf to india, myanmar, and andaman and nicobar islands
description: A small heron that is common in most aquatic habitats across the Indian subcontinent. Adults in breeding plumage have a dark reddish brown back that contrasts with a yellowish head, neck, and breast.

name: Grant's Bluebill
rangeDescription: Primary forest of eastern democratic republic of the congo and southwestern uganda
description: A large, chunky-headed black-and-red forest waxbill with a blue-and-red bill. Sexes differ: the male has a red forehead extending to the midcrown and eyes that appear to be rimmed by black spectacles, while the female has white spots on the belly and red only on the throat and rump.

name: Sao Tome Weaver
rangeDescription: Highlands of são tomé (gulf of guinea)
description: A medium-sized weaver with white wingbars, endemic to São Tomé. Sexes look quite different: the male has olive-brown upperparts and a burnt-orange face and upper breast, while the female is more washed-out dull brown above and buff-white below.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Gray-headed Greenbul
rangeDescription: Montane rainforest of southeastern nigeria and southwestern cameroon
description: A large and relatively colorful greenbul of the mountains of Cameroon and southeastern Nigeria. Note the gray head, olive-green back and tail, yellow belly, and white throat.

name: Least Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds canada and usa; winters northern mexico to panama
description: Small, grayish-olive flycatcher; very similar to several other species. Look for relatively bold white eyeing, small bill, and frequent wing flicking.
